faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to your questions regarding metal doors and motors
faq.q1: How long does it take to install a sectional door?
faq.a1: Typically full installation takes between 4 and 8 hours depending on dimensions.
faq.q2: Do you offer emergency service outside business hours?
faq.a2: Yes, we offer 24/7 emergency service 365 days a year for urgent door blockages.
faq.q3: What warranty comes with motors and automation?
faq.a3: All new motors come with a 2-year manufacturer warranty plus installation guarantee.
